description: Normalize whitespace: trim trailing spaces, collapse blank lines, normalize line endings (LF/CRLF), convert tabs to spaces. Useful for cleaning code, configs, and text before processing.

collapse_blanks.description: Collapse runs of blank lines down to max_blank_lines (default: true)

max_blank_lines.description: Blank lines to keep when collapsing, 0-10 (default: 2)

tab_to_spaces.description: Convert tabs to N spaces (omit to keep tabs)

trim_lines.description: Trim trailing whitespace from each line (default: true)

name: normalize_whitespace
